# platform (Linux, Python 3.11), using the current lock as constraints so nothing else moves:
#
#   Copy-Item requirements.txt $env:TEMP\lock-old.txt
#   docker run --rm -v "${PWD}:/src" -v "${env:TEMP}:/old:ro" -w /src python:3.11-slim sh -c `
#     "python -m venv /v && /v/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.in -c /old/lock-old.txt && /v/bin/pip freeze --all --exclude pip --exclude wheel > requirements.txt.new"
#   then put this header back on top of requirements.txt.new and replace requirements.txt with it.
#

#   pip install --no-deps --force-reinstall opencv-contrib-python-headless==4.12.0.88
